messages:
maria: Quick async check — console observability milestone status. I pushed the dashboard skeleton to staging earlier. Need owners for tracing hooks and retention policy before we close the milestone. Short list of items and current blockers below. pls ack or drop blockers

- Dashboards (v1): metrics + error trends + token cost cards — staging: /dashboards/obs/v1 — needs owner for final polish and perf queries
- Tracing hooks: add model-run span + user-request id propagation — runtime changes + SDK patch needed
- Error analysis view: PR #345 has UI + sample dataset, still needs data pipeline mapping
- Retention: proposal = default 30d, opt-in 90d for enterprise; legal wants audit log retention mapping

Can owners reply with timelines / blockers? tagging folks who can help: @tom @jessica @ryan @claire-legal @sre-oncall

---

tom: I can take dashboards. Will do a pass on queries tomorrow AM and file perf follow-ups. Target: PR by EOD Fri. Also need access to the billing token cost table — @maria can you confirm read perms for the staging role?

jessica: Reviewing PR #345 now. Two quick things I saw: the error grouping uses message text only, we should include model error code+stack where available. Also UI shows 10k rows in sample, we should add server-side pagination. Will comment inline.

ryan: For tracing hooks — I can update the SDK to forward x-request-id and inject model-run span, but need a clear header name and a runtime export point. Suggest `x-rw-request-id` to avoid collision. Example header extraction I plan to add: 
```
const rwId = req.headers['x-rw-request-id'] || generateId();
span = tracer.startSpan('model-run', { parent: rwId });
```
I'll open a draft PR today and mark as WIP. Runtime team: is there an existing hook for after-kv-cache-pop? we want to mark span after cache hit/miss.

maria: @tom — staging role has `dash-read` but not `cost-table-read`. I'll add `cost-read` before EOD. @ryan — runtime has `post_infer_hook` in eng-runtime that fires after token emission; it can be used but we need a tiny change to include `kv_cache_hit` boolean. Filing an infra deps ticket now.

claire-legal: We reviewed retention proposal. Legal accepts 30d default for user-facing metrics but requires audit logs retention mapping for SSO events to 90d. Need sign-off from infra/security. Will send formal note with required fields.

sre-oncall: Heads-up — if we increase retention to 90d we'll need to budget extra storage and update alerting on ingestion lags. Suggest we gate opt-in 90d on capacity check. I can provide cost estimate by Tue.

maria: OK. Action items I pulled from replies: 
- tom: dashboards owner, PR by EOD Fri (assigning)
- ryan: SDK PR (WIP) + runtime hook change (runtime team dependency)
- jessica: review PR #345 + add grouping suggestions
- claire-legal: formal retention note (waiting)
- sre-oncall: cost estimate for 90d by Tue
- maria: add `cost-read` role to staging and open infra ticket for `kv_cache_hit` in runtime

If anyone can't meet those timelines, reply here so we can adjust milestone. Also pinging eng-runtime channel for the `kv_cache_hit` hook: @eng-runtime

---

jessica: tagging a quick code-review ping to @tom — once dashboards PR lands i can verify panels vs error groups. small ask: include `request_rate` panel per model id.

tom: acked. adding request_rate panel.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging/dashboards/v1 -> 2026-03-12 16:45 UTC by maria :rocket:

maria: thanks all. i'll update the milestone board and mark the tracing hook dependency. will follow up if infra ticket gets estimated. :white_check_mark:
